title: Association between prenatal exposure to alkylphenols and intelligence quotient among preschool children: sex-specific effects.
ehr_evidence: Reproductive and birth outcome information including gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational age, maternal age at delivery, child sex, birth weight and birth length was abstracted from the electronic medical records.
summary: A prospective birth-cohort study of 221 mother-child pairs from the Guangxi Zhuang Birth Cohort examining associations between early-pregnancy maternal serum alkylphenol concentrations and childhood IQ assessed by WPPSI-IV at 3 to 6 years.
key_findings: Each unit increase in log10-transformed maternal nonylphenol (NP) exposure was associated with a 2.38 (95% CI: -4.59, -0.16) decrease in full-scale IQ (FSIQ).
Mothers in the second tertile of 4-tert-octylphenol (4-T-OP) were inversely associated with working memory index (WMI) (β = -5.24; 95% CI: -9.58, -0.89).
Mothers in the third tertile of 4-n-nonylphenol (4-N-NP) were positively associated with fluid reasoning index (FRI) (β = 4.95; 95% CI: 1.14, 8.77).
A U-shaped/nonlinear relationship was found between maternal 4-T-OP and WMI in total children (P nonlinear = 0.017).

Among girls, each unit increase in 4-n-octylphenol (4-N-OP) was associated with a 10.30 (95% CI: 1.18, 19.43) increase in WMI, and the third tertile of 4-N-NP with a 6.66 (95% CI: 0.96, 12.36) increase in FRI.
No significant combined effects of the AP mixture on childhood IQ were found in the BKMR model.
Significant decreases in FSIQ were observed when NP concentrations increased from the 25th to the 75th percentiles, but not significantly in boys or girls separately.
captured_features: Maternal serum alkylphenol concentrations (NP, 4-N-NP, 4-T-OP, 4-N-OP) measured by UPLC-MS/MS in early pregnancy
WPPSI-IV subscale scores (VCI, VSI, WMI, FRI, PSI) and full-scale IQ (FSIQ)
Maternal age at delivery, pre-pregnancy BMI, maternal education, passive smoking, household income, folic acid supplementation, breastfeeding duration, child age and sex
Gestational age, birth weight, birth length, gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus
pathologies_diseases: Childhood cognitive function / intelligence quotient (neurocognitive development outcomes); no specific disease
study_design: Prospective birth-cohort study (subset of the Guangxi Zhuang Birth Cohort)
data_source_type: birth cohort (biospecimen exposure; electronic medical records for covariates)
population: 221 mother-child pairs from the Guangxi Zhuang Birth Cohort, China; children aged 3 to 6 years at IQ assessment
exposure_domain: Alkylphenols (endocrine-disrupting chemicals, prenatal environmental chemical exposure)
limitations: Potential confounders not considered, such as maternal occupation and maternal IQ.
AP levels measured only in maternal serum in early pregnancy, risking exposure misclassification and uncertainty of the exposure window.
